rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for taking part in a public or social campaign, except when the campaign is specifically electoral.

example.english: We took part in a campaign to help clean up the beach.
example.traditional: 我哋參與運動，幫手清理海灘。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 caam1 jyu6 wan6 dung6 bong1 sau2 cing1 lei5 hoi2 taan1

rows.jyutping: caam1 jyu6 ging6 syun2 wut6 dung6
rows.note: Use this specifically when taking part in an election campaign rather than campaigning for a social cause.

example.english: They took part in an election campaign, going door to door for votes.
example.traditional: 佢哋參與競選活動，逐家逐戶拉票。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 caam1 jyu6 ging6 syun2 wut6 dung6 zuk6 gaa1 zuk6 wu6 laai1 piu3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a goal-oriented campaign when no specific type is being highlighted.

example.english: The beach-cleaning campaign lasted a whole month.
example.traditional: 今次清潔海灘行動搞咗成個月。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 cing1 git3 hoi2 taan1 haang4 dung6 gaau2 zo2 seng4 go3 jyut6

rows.note: Use this for an election campaign rather than a general campaign.

example.english: Their election campaign has now fully begun.
example.traditional: 佢哋嘅競選活動已經全面展開。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ge3 ging6 syun2 wut6 dung6 ji5 ging1 cyun4 min6 zin2 hoi1

rows.note: Use this for a sustained public, political, or social campaign such as an environmental campaign.

example.english: The campaign to protect the oceans needs everyone to take part.
example.traditional: 保護海洋運動需要大家一齊參加。
example.jyutping: bou2 wu6 hoi2 joeng4 wan6 dung6 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for a publicity, advertising, or promotional campaign.

example.english: This new product's promotional campaign is even giving away movie tickets!
example.traditional: 呢個新產品嘅宣傳活動仲送戲飛㗎！
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 syun1 cyun4 wut6 dung6 zung6 sung3 hei3 fei1 gaa3
